name: inia-workspace
description: INIA — Supervisora Virtual com IA. Comandos de instalação e execução (backend + frontend).

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.examples:up: node scripts/install/example-databases.mjs && docker compose --profile external-examples up -d --build --wait
scripts.examples:down: docker compose --profile external-examples --profile external-example-sqlserver stop example-postgres example-mariadb example-mysql example-sqlserver
scripts.examples:sqlserver:up: node scripts/install/example-databases.mjs && docker compose --profile external-example-sqlserver up -d --build --wait example-sqlserver && docker compose --profile external-example-sqlserver run --rm example-sqlserver-init
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
